findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria.

The quat sanitizer in the three part sink barely registers a color change on the inspector’s test strip. PIC indicated that the solution is likely from yesterday and will need to be remade. Solution remade during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
4-903.11: (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. 

Plastic knives are store with the eating and hand contact sections mixed in the consumer self service container. PIC consulted and instructed to store these items so that reaching for the handle of one knife does not contaminate the eating surface of another.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
PIC does not have current certified food protection manager (CFPM) certificate. Ensure sufficient CFPMs on staff to cover all shifts of food prep and service.
2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Open gallon of milk observed in the service counter fridge. Label with date container was opened. CORRECTED- PIC stated that milk was opened on Wednesday. Container was labeled with date opened.
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1. (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date. [Pf]

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Disposable paper towels observed stored under the service counter handwashing sink. Store paper towels where they are protected from any potential contamination.
4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination. [C]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Quat test strips are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Chlorine test strips are available in the dry storage/3 comp sink area, but no quat test strips. CORRECTED- PIC found an unopened package of quat test strips in another storage room. Ensure test strips are available for all sanitizers used within the facility.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
PIC does not have current food handler training. Ensure any staff involved in food prep have completed food handler training (and work under the supervision of a CFPM).
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement. [C]
